themes.title: Populist Right Momentum Ahead of Elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in the United States, France, and Norway are escalating campaign efforts and strategic organization ahead of key electoral milestones. From high-profile nationwide rallies to party congresses and platform development, populist leaders are seeking to consolidate political momentum.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet

themes.title: Hardline Anti‑Immigration Policies Surge
themes.blurb: Anti-immigration framing and aggressive border enforcement remain central focal points for right-wing parties in both the United States and Europe. Political figures are utilizing legal actions and public funding debates to advocate for strict border management and restrictions on non-citizens.
